s.note: Salmon and avocado rolls in nori, served with soy
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, fill with 200g salmon and avocado and roll tight with a mat. Slice with a wet knife. Serve with soy and pickled ginger. Smile and wave, boys.

s.n: Island sweet potato fritters with mango salsa
s.note: Crisp spiced sweet potato fritters with a mango, chilli and lime salsa
s.how: Squeeze the grated sweet potato in a clean tea towel to dry it. Mix with the spring onions, eggs, flour, cumin and a good pinch of salt. Fry heaped spoonfuls in the oil over medium heat, flattened, 3 minutes a side until crisp and cooked through. Drain on paper towel. Mix the mango, chilli, lime juice and chopped coriander with a pinch of salt. Serve the fritters hot with the salsa on top.

m.note: Pan seared rib eye, garlic butter, fries. Sweet, juicy steak.
m.how: Dry-brine 4 rib eyes overnight. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute, and pull at 54C. Rest 8 minutes and top with 60g butter mashed with garlic and parsley. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into shoestrings.

w.note: Grilled pineapple wedges in brown sugar caramel butter
w.how: Cut 1 pineapple into 8 long wedges and grill on a hot pan or barbecue for 3 minutes a side until charred. Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar, bubble for 2 minutes, then stir in the juice of a lime and a pinch of salt. Toss the pineapple in the caramel. Serve warm with scoops of coconut ice cream and toasted coconut flakes.

w.note: Zebra-striped chocolate brownies. Don't abuse the wish.
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 120g butter, whisk in 200g sugar and 2 eggs and fold in 80g flour. Beat 200g cream cheese with 50g sugar and 1 egg. Spread the brownie in a tin and swirl the cheesecake through in stripes. Bake at 170C for 30 minutes.

d.note: Mango, pineapple, passionfruit and lime, for the New York giants
d.how: In a large jug stir 600ml mango nectar, 300ml pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Add diced mango and pineapple and plenty of crushed ice. Top with 600ml chilled lemonade just before serving and pour into tall glasses with a lime wedge.
